home.why_squalane_body: A skin-identical oil that sinks in fast and holds moisture where lips lose it first.
home.why_shea_body: Rich fatty acids that soften dry patches and keep lips smooth for hours.
home.why_ceramides_body: The lipids your skin barrier is built from. They help lips hold on to their own moisture.
home.why_colour_body: A sheer-to-buildable tint in five shades, with a juicy, balmy finish.
